teacher_info.introduction:
I am a graduate and native English speaker with over six years teaching experience, both in the U.K and abroad. I started teaching in Vietnam in 2010, where I obtained my CELTA teaching qualification, and taught at various schools, including Hanoi Academy Bilingual School. On returning to the UK, I initially taught in Southampton and then at The Winchester School of English, where I have been employed as a full-time teacher for over four years, teaching both general and exam preparation classes. 

Although I enjoy teaching students in a group context, I feel that on a one to one basis a student's individual needs can be better catered for. The aim of my online lessons, is to provide teaching based on each student's specific interests and requirements. If you decide to take a trial lesson with me, I will find out your level and discuss your needs. I will use this introduction to plan future lessons, which I hope will be both useful and enjoyable.

I offer the following lesson types: 

ENGLISH CONVERSATION. This could be on topics that interest you or for situations where you need to use English; a job or interview for example. I will help you with any grammar, pronunciation and vocabulary problems you may have during the conversation. 

ENGLISH SKILLS. These lessons are designed to look at certain areas in more detail. If you feel you need to work more on grammar, pronunciation, vocabulary or need to prepare for an English exam (IELTS. CAE or FCE) I can help you.

BRITISH PRONUNCIATION. If you would like to improve your pronunciation and learn 'the music of English', then this is the course for you. We will look at intonation, sentence stress and the correct production of vowel/consonant sounds. I will focus on reducing pronunciation problems particular to your native language and you will learn to speak in an expressive and natural way.

I hope we will have fun and enjoy learning together and I look forward to meeting you online soon.

Live Corrections: Receive real-time feedback on grammar, word choice, and pronunciation.
Confidence Building: Improve your ability to speak naturally and respond to everyday situations.
Tailored Feedback: Personalize your learning by focusing on areas where you need the most improvement.
Who Should Enroll?

Learners aiming to improve speaking fluency and confidence
Professionals and students who want natural conversation practice with corrections
Anyone looking to enhance their everyday communication skills in English
Duration: Flexible sessions to fit your schedule and goals.

Enroll today to improve your English fluency with real-time feedback and corrections!

1.  How to make introductions, greetings
2. Nationalities
3. Possessive Adjectives
4. Describing people
5. Telling the time
6. Jobs routines 
7. Family
8. Free time
9. The weather
10. I like it.
11. Review
12 Online Exam

pro_course_detail.title: Learn to read and improve pronunciation with the Super Phonics Class! For Children or Adults!
pro_course_detail.description:
Learn to read using simple methodology from videos, songs, and other interesting materials. Practice using recorded class Zoom videos and screenshot files which are sent to you after every session.
1. Learn the phonetic alphabet for short vowels and consonants.
2. Advance on to digraphs, combinations of two-letter sounds, for example, 'oo,' 'oi,' 'oy,' 'ew.'
3. Learn complex phonic differences for example between, 'sh,' 'ch,' and the different sounds of 'th.'
4. Explore consonants that have vowel sounds such as, 'y,' /y/, and 'y' /i/.
5. Understand different rules of reading such as changing words from a short vowel sound into a long vowel sound for example: 'lit,' has a short 'i' sound but when we add an 'e,' to the word, it has a long 'i' sound. 'lite,' 
6. Understand the phonics reading of one or more syllable words.
There are many more interesting aspects of this course such as techniques on how to solve difficult pronunciation issues. An example is forming the 'l' sound and the 'r' sound.

pro_course_detail.title: Language essentials Speaking & Listening Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
Depending on what the student would like to discuss, a class is prepared specifically on general or specific subjects chosen between the teacher and the student, some examples are: travelling, hobbies and interests, your studies, your professional life, the environment, country and city life, technology.....

This is a perfect opportunity for you to practise your conversation and listening skills and to improve vocabulary and typical expressions and idioms.

Some homework can be included if you would like to reinforce what's been discussed and seen in the class.

An individual class can be booked or special packages of 5/10/20 classes.

pro_course_detail.title: Business English - negotiating skills, telephone language, how to deal with customers and suppliers, interview preparation practice, improve your presentations, give an effective meeting....
pro_course_detail.description:
This course involves a made to measure study plan, according to the needs of each student and can cover areas such as: job interviews and career English; telephone skills; negotiating; meetings; customer service skills; presentations; emails, letters and written correspondence; business communication and management skills;  social and cultural awareness skills; talking about your work/company; describing graphs and financial statements,  making a complaint, amongst others. 

Depending on the student's professional needs and objectives a course can be prepared.  Specialist vocabulary and expressions related to working are covered along with professional skills that are essential nowadays for effective communication. In addition grammar will be covered as and when needed and also pronunciation practise to maximise general fluency.   

As you can see on my profile, I have a specific qualifiation in business English teaching also in career guidance and personal development.

It's possible to book a single class for example to prepare for an important interview / meeting /business trip or to book a package that covers a range of areas as preferred. 

I am very experienced in interview preparation for both academic and professional applications. For thorough preparation, I recommend minimum 3 hours. 

A specialist course in the area of international trade can be organised on request (this service is made-to-measure and is available on request, rates to be agreed).

The classes are dynamic, practical, communicative and student focused at all times. 

I offer special packages of 5/10/20 classes. 

Please contact me if you have any queries and /or special requests.

pro_course_detail.title: Kids
pro_course_detail.description:
Children from minimum age of 11 and up to 17. Students need to already have a basic level in English and to have had some classes before when they start the course. 

We will focus on helping them to improve their speaking, listening, reading, writing, grammar, pronunciation and vocabulary skills. Depending on the student's needs and level the teacher will adapt the materials and activities accordingly. 

I use colourful and lively books and stories, videos and exercises from the British Council and other online resources and I adapt the materials depending on the level and preferred learning method, level and progress of the student. 

I also do songs and a variety of games, using flashcards, stuffed animals and real objects to help engage children's imagination and stimulate learning. 


The lessons will be interactive and a lot of fun! 

An individual class can be booked or special packages of 5/10/20 classes. 

Please contact me if you have any queries and /or special requests:)

pro_course_detail.title: Language essentials course from elementary to advanced (A1-C2)

This is a general English course studying grammar, pronunciation, writing, listening and speaking.

We will cover:

Grammar
Speaking
Listening
Writing
Reading
Pronunciation
Vocabulary

I will use a wide range of different materials to improve your skills such as readings, conversation, listenings, writing activities, word games amongst others. Above all the classes will be practical, dynamic and communicative. 

Minimum age for this course is 16 years old. 

I can identify areas where you are particularly strong and areas which require more attention and we can work on a study plan together to help you reach your objectives.

An individual class can be booked or special packages of 5/10/20 classes. 

Please contact me if you have any queries and /or special requests:)

pro_course_detail.title: English for tourism
pro_course_detail.description:
This course is for students who are studying tourism, for professionals who are working in the tourist sector and for others who would like to work in the sector in the near future. 

This course can also be adapted to students who would like to practise their English in practical situations related with travel, for example for those who will be travelling at some point and need more English.

The course covers: accommodation; international travel; bars and restaurants; travel agency and tour operators; how to book a holiday using holiday brochures or information online; preparation of tour itinerary and planning a tour schedule; how to sort out and manage travel problems when abroad. 

The main objectives of the course will be to boost students’ confidence when speaking and listening to English related to typical travel situations and also to understand vocabulary and expressions related to the tourist sector. 

The course is made-to-measure so depending on the student's needs and objectives, and the course content and skills to be developed can be adapted.

I offer special packages of 5/10/20 classes. 

Please contact me if you have any queries and /or special requests:)

pro_course_detail.title: Test Preparation for IELTS, Cambridge exams, TOEFL...
pro_course_detail.description:
This class is to help you meet your required expectations in practicing for an official English Language Test. IELTS, TOEFL and PET (B1), FCE (B2), CAE (C1), CPE (C2) can all be practiced here with supplementary exercises and practice given by the teacher. 

What is covered on the course? All aspects of the speaking interview are covered, with ideas on how to approach the examiner’s questions. 

I can also help you to improve your range of vocabulary and to learn useful expressions on any topic that can be used in all parts of the academic study test chosen.

Please note, I am not an official examiner, although I can help you to prepare the exams.

I offer special packages of 5/10/20 classes. 

Please contact me if you have any queries and /or special requests:)
